diagnosis_summary: The public workspace block permits historical access server-side when the course allows it, but the reviewed client source chooses the completion screen before honoring an activity query parameter whenever every activity is complete. It clears the selected activity while showing the completion view; desktop retains a visible activity list, while the mobile presentation depends on the collapsed selector. This supports the reported navigation difference, but no public fix or exact package boundary is recorded.
workaround_summaries: For completed courses that must remain browsable, direct learners to the desktop workspace until the mobile selector behavior is fixed, and verify historical access with a completed test learner on every supported viewport.

verification_playbook.goal: Determine whether completed learners lose historical activity navigation only on narrow viewports.
prerequisites: Use an existing non-sensitive test learner whose class is complete.
Confirm the course is configured to allow historical access.

steps.title: Inspect historical access configuration
steps.instructions: View the course and class configuration without saving and record only whether historical access is enabled for completed learners.
steps.expected_if_affected: Historical access is enabled, so the server-side prerequisite for browsing completed content is present.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: Historical access is disabled; inability to browse completed content is then expected configuration rather than this issue.
evidence_to_record: historical access enabled yes or no

steps.title: Compare completed workspace navigation
steps.instructions: Using the same completed test learner, open the workspace at desktop and narrow mobile viewport widths without submitting work. Record only whether prior activities remain selectable in each view.
steps.expected_if_affected: Desktop exposes prior activities while the narrow view remains on the completion screen without an accessible activity selector.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: Prior activities remain selectable on both viewports, or neither viewport permits access because configuration disables it.
evidence_to_record: desktop activities selectable yes or no
mobile activities selectable yes or no

limitations: Use a test learner because opening activities can update ordinary interaction telemetry even when course progress does not change.
One browser width does not cover every mobile shell or embedded webview.

context.scope: completed LMS classes with historical access enabled on narrow browser viewports
